structure: retinal photoreceptor types (rod and cone morphotypes)
measurement: count of photoreceptor types: one rod type and two cone types (one with a red oil droplet)
method: light and electron microscopy of fixed retina (ultrastructure)
conditions: Juvenile P. dolloi: eyes from three juveniles (TL 20.6, 20.2 and 24 cm) from the University of Bonn; the Table 2 footnote says all measurements are from one individual 20.6 cm TL. Light and electron microscopy of fixed retina (post-fixation shrinkage 6.3%).
